generated_note: Active in-play indicators assembled from S3: WB+FAOSTAT from indicators/indicators.json (status=process) + V-Dem from fleet-run-1 cards. 2026-05-31.

indicators.name: Average dietary energy supply adequacy (%)
indicators.description: 3-year avg of adequacy of calorie supply vs minimum requirement. FAOSTAT FS.

indicators.name: Prevalence of undernourishment (%)
indicators.description: Share of population with insufficient habitual food consumption. 3-year avg. FAOSTAT FS.

indicators.name: Cereal import dependency ratio (%)
indicators.description: Cereal imports / (production + imports - exports). Trade vulnerability signal. FAOSTAT FS.

indicators.name: Population using safely managed drinking water (%)
indicators.description: SDG 6.1.1 indicator. Core development + governance signal. FAOSTAT FS.

indicators.name: Population using at least basic sanitation services (%)
indicators.description: SDG 6.2.1 tier-3 indicator. Dev / governance signal. FAOSTAT FS.

indicators.name: Power Distributed by Sexual Orientation
indicators.description: Only global indicator tracking LGBTQ+ political inclusion. Sharp movements predict social_policy_reform. Hungary/Russia (declining) vs Taiwan/Ireland (rising) follow distinct recipes. Fills a complete event-category gap.

indicators.name: Civil Society Participatory Environment
indicators.description: **Single biggest gap for Social Mobilization family.** Measures actual mobilization capacity (vs legal permission). Low + sudden liberalization = explosion of mobilization (Eastern Europe 1989). Directly serves mass_protest, labor_action, social_policy_reform.

indicators.name: CSO Entry/Exit Freedom
indicators.description: Foundational enabler/disabler of mobilization. Civil society can't organize protests without right to form. Distinct from VD-05 (repression of *existing* organizations).

indicators.name: Executive Corruption
indicators.description: How corrupt is the executive branch specifically (not the country in general)? More targeted than WB's Control of Corruption which is economy-wide perception.

indicators.name: Private Civil Liberties Index
indicators.description: Property rights + freedom of movement + religion + equality before law. Property rights collapse precedes migration_and_refugees + economic_crisis. Religious freedom restrictions precede sectarian violence.

indicators.name: Women's Political Empowerment Index
indicators.description: Primary substrate for gender_policy_reform (currently zero substrate). Cross-family: low scores predict democratic backsliding + authoritarian consolidation.

indicators.name: Rule of Law Index
indicators.description: **Most cross-cutting V-Dem variable.** Distinct from VD-03/04 (formal constraints): measures *actual functioning* of legal system. Adds signal to 6 of 8 recipe families. 200+ years of expert-coded depth vs WB WGI's perception measure.

indicators.name: Political Participation
indicators.description: How actively do citizens engage in politics beyond voting? High participation + weak institutions = revolution risk. Low participation = coup risk (no one defends the regime).

indicators.name: Political Civil Liberties Index
indicators.description: Captures pre-violence repression: assembly→association→expression. Regimes that restrict political liberties before violence have a different trajectory. The gap between VD-15 and VD-12 is itself informative.

indicators.name: Power Distributed by Gender
indicators.description: Static power-distribution measure. Combo with VD-26 distinguishes "formal rights but no power" (high VD-26 trajectory + low VD-27) — backlash regime type with specific instability patterns.

indicators.name: Civil Society Repression
indicators.description: Is the government shutting down NGOs, arresting activists, restricting assembly? Escalating repression precedes political_violence and democratic breakdown.

indicators.name: Bicameralism
indicators.description: Static institutional moderator. UK government collapse (bicameral) ≠ Turkey executive consolidation. Allows recipe filtering by institutional structure.

indicators.name: Freedom from Political Killings
indicators.description: Direct antecedent for political_violence + human_rights_violation. A drop precedes regime-crisis events 1-2 years out. Isolates the "targeted assassination" channel that VD-12 blends into a composite.

indicators.name: Power Distributed by Socioeconomic Position
indicators.description: Class-politics indicator entirely missing today. High elite capture predicts mass_protest + populist executive_transition. Arab Spring + LatAm pink tide + global populist wave all show high VD-28.

indicators.name: Neopatrimonialism Index
indicators.description: Patronage-network architecture. When network collapses (resource curse reversal, succession crisis), entire structure disintegrates rapidly. Primary recipe substrate for SSA + Central Asia + parts of MENA.

indicators.name: Liberal Democracy Index
indicators.description: Electoral democracy + rule of law + civil liberties. The gap between VD-01 and VD-02 reveals "democratic facade" regimes — elections without genuine freedom. Use as the stable-democracy salience discount factor.

indicators.name: Domestic Autonomy / Sovereignty
indicators.description: One of few V-Dem indicators serving Diplomacy & Geopolitics. Sovereignty collapse from 0.7 to 0.3 = foreign_intervention happening in real time. No WB indicator captures this.

indicators.name: Legislative Constraints on Executive
indicators.description: Can parliament block the president? When this drops alongside VD-03, institutional checks are collapsing — strong signal for authoritarian consolidation.

indicators.name: Free and Fair Elections Index
indicators.description: elections + election_violence have no dedicated indicator today. VD-32 isolates electoral process specifically (vs VD-01 broader composite). Declining VD-32 with stable VD-01 = pre-fraud signal.

indicators.name: Freedom from Torture
indicators.description: Leading indicator for political_repression + human_rights_violation. Regimes escalate torture before mass killings or crackdowns become visible. Independent measurement path from VD-12.

indicators.name: Print/Broadcast Media Censorship
indicators.description: Historically deep signal for political_repression + democratic_transition where VD-08's alternative-information component is signal-poor pre-1990. Critical for pre-internet recipes.

indicators.name: Judicial Reform Attempts
indicators.description: Captures the executive *trying* to attack judicial independence (action), not just the outcome (VD-03). Reform attempts precede independence erosion 1-3 years. Direct substrate for judicial_reform.

indicators.name: Power Distributed by Social Group (Ethnic)
indicators.description: **Strongest structural predictor of civil war onset** in political-science literature (Cederman, Wimmer). Tamils/Kurds/Tutsis all follow this recipe. Pairs with WB ethnic fractionalization.

indicators.name: Legitimacy of Political Leadership
indicators.description: Legitimacy collapse without losing power = pre-coup/pre-protest danger zone. Distinct from VD-01 (institutional quality) — measures perceived legitimacy. Cross-family signal.

indicators.name: Party Linkages to Voters
indicators.description: Distinguishes clientelistic (Venezuela/Iraq) vs programmatic (austerity-resilient) vs identity (channels stress to ethnic/religious mobilization). No other indicator enables this differentiation.

indicators.name: Electoral Democracy Index
indicators.description: Core democracy score. When this declines, a country is backsliding — precedes constitutional_change, protest, political_crisis. When it rises, democratic transition is underway.

indicators.name: Political Corruption Index
indicators.description: Whole-of-government corruption (vs VD-07 executive-only). Gap between VD-07 and VD-18 reveals centralized (kleptocratic) vs diffuse (failed-state) corruption — different recipe trajectories.

indicators.name: Regime Type
indicators.description: 0=closed autocracy, 1=electoral autocracy, 2=electoral democracy, 3=liberal democracy. Regime transitions between categories ARE the events QGI predicts. Use as a state variable for filtering.

indicators.name: Physical Violence Index
indicators.description: Physical integrity rights — freedom from torture, extrajudicial killing, political imprisonment. Escalating violations are a 1-2 year leading indicator for political_violence and civil_war.

indicators.name: Equal Protection Index
indicators.description: Group-differentiated rights (ethnic/religious/gender). Decline precedes sectarian violence + minority persecution. Combines with WB ethnic fractionalization for compound communal-violence recipe.

indicators.name: Fiscal Capacity
indicators.description: Can the government actually tax + deliver services? Substitute for the legacy v2stcapacity (renamed/retired in V-Dem v16, 2026-04). Low capacity + external stress = state failure → civil_war, humanitarian_crisis.

indicators.name: Freedom of Expression
indicators.description: Media freedom + access to alternative information sources. When a government starts controlling media, it's preparing for something. 1-3 year leading indicator for authoritarian moves.

indicators.name: Legislature Questions Officials in Practice
indicators.description: Operational measure of legislative accountability (vs VD-04 formal capability). Parliament that stops asking questions before formal constitutional change = early warning.
Can courts block the president? When this drops, executive power grab is underway. 2-4 year leading indicator for constitutional_change and democratic backsliding.
Is society splitting into irreconcilable camps? High polarization precedes constitutional crises, government formation failures, and election violence.

indicators.name: Population, total
indicators.description: Total population is based on the de facto definition of population.

indicators.name: Inflation, GDP deflator (annual %)
indicators.description: Inflation as measured by the annual growth rate of the GDP implicit deflator.

indicators.name: GDP growth (annual %)
indicators.description: Annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices based on constant local currency.

indicators.name: GNI per capita, Atlas method (current US$)
indicators.description: GNI per capita is the gross national income, converted to U.S. dollars using the World Bank Atlas method, divided by the midyear population.

indicators.name: Net migration
indicators.description: Net migration is the net total of migrants during the period, that is, the number of immigrants minus the number of emigrants.

indicators.name: Life expectancy at birth, total (years)
indicators.description: Indicates the number of years a newborn infant would live if prevailing patterns of mortality at the time of its birth were to stay the same throughout its life.

indicators.name: Arms imports (SIPRI trend indicator values)
indicators.description: Arms transfers cover the supply of military weapons through sales, aid, gifts, and licenses and leases.

indicators.name: Mortality rate, under-5
indicators.description: The probability per 1,000 that a newborn baby will die before reaching age five.

indicators.name: Fertility rate, total (births per woman)
indicators.description: The number of children that would be born to a woman if she were to live to the end of her childbearing years and bear children in accordance with age-specific fertility rates of the specified year.

indicators.name: Food production index
indicators.description: Food production index covers food crops that are considered edible and that contain nutrients.

indicators.name: Imports of goods and services (current US$)
indicators.description: The value of all goods and other market services received from the rest of the world.

indicators.name: Military expenditure (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Military expenditures data from SIPRI as a share of GDP.

indicators.name: Services, value added (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Value added in services as a percentage of GDP.

indicators.name: General government final consumption expenditure (% of GDP)
indicators.description: General government final consumption expenditure as a percentage of GDP.

indicators.name: Current account balance (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Current account balance as a percentage of GDP.

indicators.name: GDP (current US$)
indicators.description: GDP at purchaser's prices is the sum of gross value added by all resident producers in the economy plus any product taxes and minus any subsidies not included in the value of the products.

indicators.name: GDP per capita (current US$)
indicators.description: GDP per capita is gross domestic product divided by midyear population.

indicators.name: Access to electricity, urban (% of urban population)
indicators.description: The percentage of the urban population with access to electricity.

indicators.name: Exports of goods and services (% of GDP)
indicators.description: The value of all goods and other market services provided to the rest of the world as a percentage of GDP.

indicators.name: Imports of goods and services (% of GDP)
indicators.description: The value of all goods and other market services received from the rest of the world as a percentage of GDP.

indicators.name: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %)
indicators.description: Inflation as measured by the consumer price index.

indicators.name: Agriculture, forestry, and fishing, value added (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Value added in agriculture, forestry, and fishing as a percentage of GDP.

indicators.name: Manufacturing, value added (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Value added in manufacturing as a percentage of GDP.

indicators.name: Gross capital formation (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Gross capital formation (formerly gross domestic investment) consists of outlays on additions to the fixed assets of the economy plus net changes in the level of inventories.

indicators.name: Households and NPISHs Final consumption expenditure (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Household final consumption expenditure as a percentage of GDP.

indicators.name: Total reserves (includes gold, current US$)
indicators.description: Total reserves comprise holdings of monetary gold, special drawing rights, reserves of IMF members held by the IMF, and holdings of foreign exchange.

indicators.name: Broad money (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Broad money (IFS line 35L..ZK) is the sum of currency outside banks; demand deposits other than those of the central government.

indicators.name: Labor force participation rate, female (% of female population ages 15-64) (modeled ILO estimate)
indicators.description: Labor force participation rate, female is the proportion of the female population ages 15-64 that is economically active.

indicators.name: Refugees under the mandate of the UNHCR by country or territory of origin
indicators.description: Number of refugees originating from a country, recognised under the UNHCR mandate. Direct measure of conflict-driven displacement output.

indicators.name: Political Stability and Absence of Violence/Terrorism (estimate)
indicators.description: Measures perceptions of the likelihood of political instability and/or politically-motivated violence.

indicators.name: School enrollment, primary (% gross)
indicators.description: Gross enrollment ratio is the ratio of total enrollment, regardless of age, to the population of the age group that officially corresponds to the level of education shown.

indicators.name: Employment to population ratio, 15+, total (%)
indicators.description: The proportion of a country's population that is employed.

indicators.name: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force)
indicators.description: The share of the labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.

indicators.name: Access to electricity, rural (% of rural population)
indicators.description: The percentage of the rural population with access to electricity.

indicators.name: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)
indicators.description: Individuals who have used the Internet (from any location) in the last 3 months.

indicators.name: Mobile cellular subscriptions
indicators.description: Subscriptions to a public mobile telephone service that provide access to the PSTN using cellular technology.

indicators.name: Exports of goods and services (current US$)
indicators.description: The value of all goods and other market services provided to the rest of the world.

indicators.name: Voice and Accountability (estimate)
indicators.description: Captures perceptions of the extent to which a country's citizens are able to participate in selecting their government.

indicators.name: Government Effectiveness (estimate)
indicators.description: Captures perceptions of the quality of public services, the quality of the civil service and the degree of its independence from political pressures.

indicators.name: Regulatory Quality (estimate)
indicators.description: Captures perceptions of the ability of the government to formulate and implement sound policies and regulations that permit and promote private sector development.

indicators.name: Rule of Law (estimate)
indicators.description: Captures perceptions of the extent to which agents have confidence in and abide by the rules of society, and in particular the quality of contract enforcement.

indicators.name: Control of Corruption (estimate)
indicators.description: Captures perceptions of the extent to which public power is exercised for private gain, including both petty and grand forms of corruption.

indicators.name: Arms exports (SIPRI trend indicator values)
indicators.description: Exports of military weapons through sales, aid, gifts, and licenses.

indicators.name: GDP
indicators.description: Gross domestic product at purchaser's prices, constant 2015 US$.

indicators.name: Industry (including construction), value added (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Value added in mining, manufacturing, construction, electricity, water, and gas as a percentage of GDP.

indicators.name: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Foreign direct investment, net inflows as a percentage of GDP.

indicators.name: Foreign direct investment, net outflows (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Foreign direct investment, net outflows as a percentage of GDP.

indicators.name: Total reserves in months of imports
indicators.description: Total reserves expressed in terms of the number of months of imports of goods and services they could pay for.

indicators.name: External debt stocks (% of GNI)
indicators.description: Total external debt stocks as a percentage of gross national income.

indicators.name: Total debt service (% of exports of goods, services and primary income)
indicators.description: The sum of principal repayments and interest actually paid in currency, goods, or services on long-term debt, interest paid on short-term debt, and repayments to the IMF.

indicators.name: Revenue, excluding grants (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Revenue is cash receipts from taxes, social contributions, and other revenues such as fines, fees, rent, and income from property or sales.

indicators.name: Tax revenue (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Tax revenue refers to compulsory transfers to the central government for public purposes.

indicators.name: Expense (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Expense is cash payments for operating activities of the government in providing goods and services.

indicators.name: Lending interest rate (%)
indicators.description: Lending rate is the bank rate that usually meets the short- and medium-term financing needs of the private sector.

indicators.name: High-technology exports (% of manufactured exports)
indicators.description: High-technology exports are products with high R&D intensity, such as in aerospace, computers, pharmaceuticals, scientific instruments, and electrical machinery.

indicators.name: Unemployment, youth total (% of total labor force ages 15-24) (modeled ILO estimate)
indicators.description: Youth unemployment refers to the share of the labor force ages 15-24 without work but available for and seeking employment.

indicators.name: Gini index
indicators.description: Gini index measures the extent to which the distribution of income (or, in some cases, consumption expenditure) among individuals or households within an economy deviates from a perfectly equal distribution.

indicators.name: Energy imports, net (% of energy use)
indicators.description: Net energy imports are estimated as energy use less production, both measured in oil equivalents.

indicators.name: CO2 emissions excluding LULUCF per capita
indicators.description: Per-capita carbon dioxide emissions (excluding land-use change and forestry), scaled with IPCC AR5 GWPs. Replaces the retired EN.ATM.CO2E.PC.

indicators.name: Battle-related deaths (number of people)
indicators.description: Number of battle deaths from intra- or inter-state armed conflict; sourced from UCDP via WB.

indicators.name: Refugee population by country or territory of origin
indicators.description: Number of refugees originating from this country (UNHCR via WB).

indicators.name: Internally displaced persons, new displacement associated with conflict and violence (number of cases)
indicators.description: New internal displacements from conflict (IDMC via WB).

indicators.name: Cost of business start-up procedures (% of GNI per capita)
indicators.description: Cost to start a business as percentage of GNI per capita; institutional quality proxy (WB Doing Business / B-READY).

indicators.name: Time required to enforce a contract (days)
indicators.description: Days needed to enforce a commercial contract through the courts; rule of law proxy (WB Doing Business / B-READY).

indicators.name: Personal remittances, paid (current US$)
indicators.description: Outbound remittances paid by workers in this country to other countries.

indicators.name: Central government debt, total (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Gross central government debt as percentage of GDP; fiscal sustainability indicator.

indicators.name: Bank nonperforming loans to total gross loans (%)
indicators.description: Ratio of NPLs to total gross loans; banking sector stress indicator.

indicators.name: Private credit by deposit money banks to GDP (%)
indicators.description: Bank assets as a percentage of GDP; financial development depth indicator (WB Global Financial Development DB).

indicators.name: Net official development assistance and official aid received (% of GNI)
indicators.description: Net ODA received as percentage of GNI; donor-dependence indicator (OECD DAC via WB).
